strings.zh: 辛夷『……喔哦！不愧是冠军大人！{NEWLINE}您果然来到了这最后的房间。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Magnus: ...Oh-ho! As expected of the{NEWLINE}Champion! You’ve made it to this final{CLEAR}room after all.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 辛夷『这里是「友情」房间,{NEWLINE}与精灵合作无间、相互信赖的人{CLEAR}才能最终到达这里。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Magnus: This is the ‘Friendship’ room.{NEWLINE}Only those who work in perfect harmony{CLEAR}with their Pokémon, trusting each other{CLEAR}completely, can make it this far.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 辛夷『恭喜您冠军大人！{NEWLINE}您的成绩足以证明{CLEAR}即使在全新的领域,{CLEAR}您也能充分发挥精灵的潜力！{SCROLL}辛夷『您是当之无愧的{NEWLINE}口袋竞技运动员,{CLEAR}您的名字将会永远留在这里！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Magnus: Congratulations, Champion!{NEWLINE}Your results prove that even in a{CLEAR}brand-new field, you can bring out your{CLEAR}Pokémon’s full potential!{SCROLL}Magnus: You are a true Pokéathlete,{NEWLINE}and your name will remain here forever!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 辛夷『但是,这也是您新的起点。{NEWLINE}在前方还有更激烈的比赛在等着您！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Magnus: But this is also a new starting{NEWLINE}line for you. Even fiercer competition{CLEAR}awaits you ahead!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 辛夷『没错！您已经听到{NEWLINE}新的开始信号了吧！{CLEAR}那是您不得不越过的更高目标。{SCROLL}辛夷『为了成为传说中的口袋竞技员{NEWLINE}请看一下这个铜像,{CLEAR}您应该能看见您所憧憬的目标……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Magnus: That’s right!{NEWLINE}Surely you’ve heard the starting signal{CLEAR}ring out again! It marks a higher goal{CLEAR}you must now clear.{SCROLL}Magnus: To become a legendary{NEWLINE}Pokéathlete, please look at this{CLEAR}statue. You should see the goal you{CLEAR}long for...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 辛夷『精灵与人类在这里{NEWLINE}立下了友情地久天长的约定,{CLEAR}口袋竞技最后的房间{CLEAR}——「友情」的房间！{SCROLL}辛夷『但是,这里并不是最后的终点！{NEWLINE}在各个房间里已经准备好了{CLEAR}象征更高目标的奖杯。{CLEAR}您可以自由选择收集奖杯,{CLEAR}或是选择向着更高的高度挑战。{SCROLL}辛夷『没错,真正的终点是自己决定的！{NEWLINE}无论什么样的困难在前方等待着,{CLEAR}靠着您和精灵友情的力量,{CLEAR}开辟新的道路吧！
strings.en: Magnus: Here, Pokémon and people{NEWLINE}made a vow of everlasting friendship.{CLEAR}This is the Pokéathlon’s final room,{CLEAR}the ‘Friendship’ room!{SCROLL}Magnus: But this is not the end of the{NEWLINE}road! Every room holds trophies that{CLEAR}stand for higher goals.{SCROLL}You are free to collect them,{NEWLINE}or to take on even greater heights.{SCROLL}Magnus: Yes, the true finish line is the{NEWLINE}one you choose yourself!{SCROLL}Whatever hardships lie ahead,{NEWLINE}blaze a new trail with the power{CLEAR}of the friendship between you and{CLEAR}your Pokémon!
